📰 每日 AI 新聞 Top 10 · 2026-11-09
1. Nvidia is investigating Jensen Huang's relationship with a Chinese spy產業
Nvidia 調查黃仁勳與疑似中國間諜的關係
Nvidia's board has opened an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang and his relationship with Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, who was reportedly recruited by China's Ministry of State Security to spy on the company.
Nvidia 董事會宣布對執行長黃仁勳與 Megaspeed 主管 Alice Huang 的關係展開調查。據報導，該主管曾被中國國家安全部招募，任務是監視 Nvidia。
The Verge · https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1029562/nvidia-investigating-jensen-huang-relationship-chinese-spy
2. Acronis reveals BossAI, an AI attack framework with 12 agents, MCP and Skills資安
Acronis 揭露 AI 自動化攻擊系統 BOSSAI 運作細節，整合 12 個 AI 代理、MCP 與 Skills
Acronis' threat research unit says BossAI targeted Taiwan's emergency services and hundreds of organizations in 11 countries. It uses 12 coordinated AI agents, MCP-connected pentest tools and local models with safety limits removed.
Acronis 威脅研究單位指出，BossAI 鎖定臺灣緊急服務系統與全球 11 國數百個組織。它由 12 個 AI 代理分工，透過 MCP 串接滲透測試工具，並使用移除安全限制的本機模型。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/180310
3. Dropbox buys Tigris for $350M to enter AI storage infrastructure產業
Dropbox 砸 3.5 億美元收購 Tigris，進軍 AI 儲存基礎設施市場
Dropbox announced it will acquire AI object-storage startup Tigris Data for $350 million. It also launched DBX Agent Cloud, expanding from file storage into data storage for AI apps and agents.
Dropbox 宣布以 3.5 億美元收購 AI 物件儲存新創 Tigris Data，並發表 DBX Agent Cloud，從傳統檔案儲存延伸到 AI 應用程式與代理人所需的資料儲存服務。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/180302
4. Apple is racing to make Siri more agentic產品
Apple 加速讓 Siri 更具代理能力
Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reports that CEO John Ternus is pushing Craig Federighi to speed up the Siri roadmap. The goal is a powerful AI agent that can compete with OpenAI's Dots and Meta's Muse.
Bloomberg 的 Mark Gurman 報導，執行長 John Ternus 正催促 Craig Federighi 加快 Siri 的開發時程。目標是推出能與 OpenAI 的 Dots、Meta 的 Muse 競爭的強大 AI 代理。
The Verge · https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1029552/apple-siri-ai-agentic
5. Microsoft Intelligent Terminal adds background execution so AI agent tasks keep running when the window closes產品
微軟 Intelligent Terminal 支援背景執行，關閉視窗不中斷 AI 代理任務
Microsoft released Intelligent Terminal 0.3 with a Headless Mode. Developers can close the terminal window and long-running work, such as AI agent tasks and builds, keeps going.
微軟發布 Intelligent Terminal 0.3，新增背景執行模式（Headless Mode）。開發者關閉終端機視窗後，AI 代理任務、程式編譯等長時間工作仍可繼續執行。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/180295
6. Hackers abuse Microsoft Entra ID to breach MSPs and hit downstream customers資安
駭客濫用 Microsoft Entra ID，入侵 MSP 並波及下游客戶
Todyl disclosed on Nov. 3 an attack on managed service providers. Attackers used stolen Entra ID app registration credentials to get into several MSPs' Microsoft 365 and Azure environments, then moved on to their downstream customers.
Todyl 於 11 月 3 日揭露一起針對代管服務供應商（MSP）的攻擊。攻擊者利用被盜的 Entra ID 應用程式註冊憑證，登入多家 MSP 的 Microsoft 365 與 Azure 環境，並進一步入侵其下游客戶。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/180315
7. Over 100 European groups unite against AI data centers and demand a pause on large projects政策
歐洲逾百團體串連反對 AI 資料中心，要求暫停大型開發案
On Nov. 6–7, more than 100 European civil groups ran the "Stop Dirty Data Centres" protests. They want governments to pause large data center development until environmental and social problems are addressed.
歐洲逾百個民間團體於 11 月 6 日至 7 日發起「停止污染性資料中心」跨國抗議，要求各國政府在環境與社會問題獲得妥善處理前，暫停大型資料中心開發。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/180307
8. Elvis and Eminem rights holders are suing Suno政策
貓王與 Eminem 的版權方控告 Suno
Rights holders of Elvis Presley's music and the publisher of some of Eminem's biggest records are suing AI music company Suno. They claim it illegally generates music and lyrics that mimic those artists.
貓王音樂的版權方與 Eminem 多首名曲的發行商控告 AI 音樂公司 Suno，指稱其非法生成模仿這些藝人的音樂與歌詞。Suno 已面臨多起類似訴訟。
The Verge · https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1029533/elvis-eminem-suno-ai-music-clone-lawsuit
9. World Models Will Soon Be Inescapable. Here's What You Need to Know研究
世界模型即將無所不在，你需要知道這些
World models move AI from text into 3D space. They simulate real-world physics to teach robots and autonomous cars how to navigate reality.
世界模型讓 AI 從文字走向 3D 空間，模擬真實世界的物理規則，用來訓練機器人與自駕車理解並在現實中移動。
Wired · https://www.wired.com/story/world-models-will-soon-be-inescapable-what-you-need-to-know/
10. Apple to scan publicly shared iCloud photos and files starting with version 27.3政策
Apple 將檢查 iCloud 公開分享的照片與檔案，27.3 版起實施
From iOS, iPadOS, macOS and visionOS 27.3, Apple will check iCloud content shared via "Anyone with the Link" for harmful content. Such content is not end-to-end encrypted, even with Advanced Data Protection on.
自 iOS、iPadOS、macOS 與 visionOS 27.3 版起，Apple 將檢查以「知道連結的任何人」公開分享的 iCloud 內容是否含有害內容。即使啟用進階資料保護，這類內容也不受端對端加密保護。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/180284
